ir.name: loss_margin_rank_sign_tanh_weighted_abs_advantage_gap_fixed_objective_sensitivity
ir.intuition: Addressed objective insensitivity by incorporating the raw advantage_gap as a multiplicative factor instead of its sign only, enhancing gradient sensitivity to advantage variations. Retained tanh smoothing and margin clamping for stability. Ensured robust weighting fallback to ones_like if missing. This change allows loss values to reflect magnitude changes in advantage_gap, ensuring sensitivity to objective perturbations and passing co_gate checks.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -10, 10)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamped_margin)
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
loss = hinge * abs(adv_gap) * weight
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    abs_adv = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(hinge, abs_adv), weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
